title: Grandma's Recipe Is In My HANDWRITING 🍲
description:
In this town, a recipe cooked right flies to whoever needs it most. So nobody cooks with the card in their hand.

My grandma has kept her soup recipe in a tin for sixty years. It's in my handwriting, and I've never written it.

It's made up. A blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment SOUP if someone in your family cooks from memory.
